title: Phone Case
description: I designed and 3D-printed a custom iPhone 13 case in Fusion, using caliper measurements and iterative prototypes to refine dimensions for accuracy and functionality.

timeline.heading: Objective
timeline.description: My phone case, the Otterbox Commuter case for the iPhone 13, has two parts: the rubber cushioning and the plastic holding it all together. For this project, I wanted to 3D model and print the plastic part since it is a challenging design to replicate and I could modify the design to give extra functionality to the case, like a wallet holder.

timeline.heading: Modeling
timeline.description: Prior to modeling, I used a digital caliper to measure the dimensions of the case. Then, I started modeling the case in Fusion. At first, I tried to create a flat sheet and extend the edges to model it into the shape of the cover, but I found it was really tedious. I tried looking for different approaches when I realized that I could create a box with the dimensions of the case, hollowing it, and make cuts into it until it looks like the case. I quickly abandoned my original strategy and went ahead with that plan. Throughout the process, I used fillets and chamfers to polish the look.

timeline.heading: Modifications
timeline.description: After modeling, I 3D-printed the case using PLA filament. The case ended up having the correct shape, but when I tried putting it on my phone, the case didn't fit as the dimensions were slightly off. I went back to the CAD model and tweak the dimensions to make it fit. This took a few attempts, but I eventually got it right. Halfway through the tweaking process, I decided to only print the edges of the case to save filament and printing time.

timeline.heading: Final product
timeline.description: After I found the correct dimensions, I printed the final version of the case in black PLA, which managed to fit on my phone. Overall, I thought this project was a success. I gained experience with tools like digital calipers and printers and learned a lot about 3D modeling and printing. In the end, I was able to replicate the original phone case for my phone. I plan to modify this case to allow accessories like a wallet holder to be attached to it to give my phone more functionality.
